provenance: Country facts are from the archived CIA World Factbook mirror. Officeholders and economic/military data are reference observations, not a live update.
summary: Kingdom of Cambodia. Parliamentary constitutional monarchy.
rulers: King Norodom SIHAMONI (since 29 October 2004); Prime Minister HUN MANET (since 22 August 2023)
economy: one of the fastest growing Southeast Asian economies; rebounding tourism and clothing exports; substantial manufacturing and construction sectors; new trade agreements expanding agricultural markets; significant public debt; investing in new ports and roads GDP (PPP): $123.676 billion (2024 est.). note: data in 2021 dollars
military: Royal Cambodian Armed Forces (RCAF): Royal Cambodian Army, Royal Khmer Navy, Royal Cambodian Air Force, Royal Gendarmerie (Military Police); National Committee for Maritime Security (2025) Expenditure: 1.5% of GDP (2024 est.)
asOf: Archived Factbook edition; individual figures retain their stated years.
